columns.name: ENDORSEMENT_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the endorsement table.

columns.name: ENDORSEMENT_TEXT
columns.description: This is the full text of the endorsement.

columns.name: ENDORSEMENT_DATE
columns.description: This is the date of the endorsement.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the topic id of the endorsement.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_ID
columns.description: This is the unique Id of the recommender.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_GBL_PRFL_ID

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_FUS_PRFL_ID
columns.description: This is the fusion profile ID of the recommender.

columns.name: ENDORSEE_FUS_PRFL_ID
columns.description: This is the fusion profile ID of the endorsee.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_NAME
columns.description: This is the name of the recommender.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_TITLE
columns.description: This is the title of the recommender.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_EMAIL
columns.description: This is the list of email addresses of the recommender.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_RELATION
columns.description: This is the relation type of the recommender.

columns.name: RECOMMENDER_IMAGE_URL
columns.description: This is the image URL of the recommender.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
